tailscale-api.$comment: All requests to the Tailscale admin REST API (api.tailscale.com), which is served under /api/v2/. Covers tailnet-wide user management (roles, approval, suspension, deletion), device management, ACL/policy, DNS, keys, logs, and webhooks. Does not cover the admin console (console.tailscale.com) or the sign-in host (login.tailscale.com), which the browser login visits but which are not API targets.

tailscale-read-all.$comment: Read anything from the Tailscale admin API: list users, devices, keys, webhooks, posture integrations, services, tailnets, DNS and logging configuration, and the policy file. Safe methods only.

tailscale-write-all.$comment: Change anything through the Tailscale admin API: change user roles, approve/suspend/restore/delete users, authorize/expire/delete devices, set device tags/routes/names, set the policy file, configure DNS and logging, create and revoke keys, and manage webhooks and OAuth apps. Covers every unsafe method.
